description:
Create directory crate-jmap-metadata-types/ as a cookie-cut sibling of jmap-mail-types (canonical extension-types template per workspace AGENTS.md).

Scaffolding:
- Cargo.toml (workspace inheritance; deps: serde, serde_json, jmap-types)
- src/lib.rs with #![forbid(unsafe_code)] and module declarations
- AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, README.md mirroring the extension-types idiom

Data types (per draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01):
- Metadata enum: Annotation, ImapMetadata, WebDavMetadata variants
- Annotation type with #[serde(flatten)] vendor-extension support
- ImapMetadata for IMAP RFC 5464 mapping
- WebDavMetadata for WebDAV dead properties
- MetadataFilterCondition (§3.4.1): @type, relatedType, relatedId/relatedIds, isPrivate, textMatch
- MetadataComparator (§3.5): id, @type, relatedType, relatedId, isPrivate

All structs/enums #[non_exhaustive] so spec evolution doesn't break SemVer.

Round-trip tests against the draft's example JSON (with explicit 'draft-01' version pinning in test names).

Add to workspace Cargo.toml as a workspace member.
title: Create new jmap-metadata-types crate (scaffolding + RFC draft data types)
